jobs.title: Senior Mobile Engineer - Grafana Ops - IRM | Germany | Remote
jobs.facts: We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. | This is a full time remote role for candidates in the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany. | As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so an independent attitude and good communication skills are a must. | You’ll be working with your teammates in a fully remote setup. | Exposure to microservices architecture and distributed systems, or a desire to learn. | Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source projects Compensatio
